status: concrete successor for independent test review; not implementation or acceptance evidence

routes.selector: org_id selects the requested Company; current server-authenticated Account and retained policy determine authority
routes.ownership: Both adapters invoke the same Payroll application read use case and retained-transaction query/audit/final-current-authority boundary. Preserve existing PayrollRunPage and all 18 PayrollRunSummary fields. Preserve legacy routes through their owners.

audit.writer: Existing common audit insertion with the reviewed typed Account actor successor; preserve legacy row encoding, columns, hashes and seals
audit.actor: actual authenticated Account of the corresponding input or terminal
audit.org_id: exact selected Company of that input or terminal
audit.after_snap_encoding: JSON object with every listed key present and no extra keys; use existing JSONB and audit row serialization, never introduce a new historical serializer
audit.string_encoding: UUIDs lowercase hyphenated; digests lowercase 64 hexadecimal characters; epochs canonical positive decimal strings; operations exact codec names

accept.target_id: actual intake_receipt_id as lowercase UUID string

complete.target_id: actual receipt_id as lowercase UUID string

after_snap_fields.result_code: terminal.result_code: installed | granted | revoked | intake_expired | revision_conflict | grant_expiry_invalid | recipient_ineligible
after_snap_fields.predecessor_receipt_id: terminal.predecessor_receipt_id as UUID string, or explicit JSON null

audit.closure: Exactly one matching lifecycle audit per input/terminal in its actual transaction/backend; match actor, Company, target, operation, original input digest, relevant session, time and every payload value. Missing/extra/incorrect keys, string/null substitutions or duplicate lifecycle audits fail closure. Accepted input does not require a terminal. Business effect details remain in the immutable terminal and its checked participants, not duplicated into audit JSON. Existing ontology install and payroll read audits remain additionally required.

test_requirements: Generate accepted and completed expectations from actual database row values independently of the writer helper; compare exact JSON object and SQL NULL separately.
Exercise a rejection and a later committed epoch with a nonnull predecessor using real owner transitions; never insert business setup rows as browser fixtures.
Mutation controls change or omit one audit field, substitute JSON null for SQL NULL, add an extra key, duplicate a matching event, or use a different session; each must fail the actual closure.
Historical audit bytes and seals remain unchanged while native Account records append and validate through the same chain.
